# What does one rental boat really earn in a short season, and should you rent it direct, list it or charter it?

> Find out what a rental boat really earns after fuel, dock, insurance, a short season and weather cancellations, and whether a marketplace listing or a captained charter pays it better.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
